internal.title: Incident Report: Cart Service High Error Rate Resolved
internal.body:
At 11:39 UTC on 2026-11-08, an alert was triggered for the cart service due to a high error rate of 25%. Initial diagnosis identified a dependency issue with the valkey-cart service, but the proposed fix was blocked by guardrails due to a target mismatch. A second diagnosis confirmed an error injection fault within the cart service itself. The remediation involved disabling the cartFailure flag, which was approved and executed promptly. The service error rate returned to normal shortly after, confirming recovery.

Timeline:
- 11:39:42: Alert received for high error rate in cart service.
- 11:59:21: Diagnosis round 1 identified valkey-cart dependency unreachable.
- 11:59:24: Initial remediation proposal blocked by guardrails.
- 11:59:29: Diagnosis round 2 identified cart service error injection.
- 11:59:31: Flag disabling proposed, approved, and executed.
- Post 11:59:31: Service error rate normalized.

Root cause was an error injection in the cart service causing elevated error rates when adding items to the cart. Recovery was verified by monitoring the error ratio metric.

Action taken: Disabled the cartFailure flag to stop the error injection and restore service functionality.

external.title: Some customers experienced issues adding items to cart
external.body: Between 11:39 and 11:59 UTC on 2026-11-08, some customers experienced issues adding items to their shopping carts due to an internal service error. Our engineering team identified and resolved the issue promptly by disabling a faulty internal process. The service has returned to normal operation and customers should no longer experience this problem. We apologize for any inconvenience caused.

output.summary: High error rate in cart service caused by internal error injection, resolved by disabling a faulty flag.
output.impact: Customers experienced failures when adding items to their carts, impacting shopping experience for approximately 20 minutes.
output.root_cause: An error injection fault in the cart service caused a high error rate when adding items to the cart.
output.resolution: Disabled the cartFailure flag to stop the error injection and restore normal service operation.

lessons.lesson: Ensure that error injection flags are carefully controlled and have proper guardrails to prevent unintended service disruptions.
lessons.applies_when: When error injection flags are enabled in the cart service.

action_items: Review and improve guardrail policies to prevent target mismatch blocking delays.
Implement additional monitoring on error injection flags to detect issues earlier.
